notes.title: CRAKEN (NEW YEAR EDITION) V 1.0 RELEASE
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES IN THIS VERSION
1. CUSTOMISATION - A lot of fashion clothes are waiting for you!
2. CRAZY EGG  GAME MODE - Shoot in face of Craken and try to catch the Easter EGG!
3. RAIN STORM  MODE - Tough hardcore test for the most desperate explorers of the deep sea. Now you can’t shoot a cannon twice in the same place - as soon as a Craken senses a threat he dives in and out in a random place in order to surely destroy you !!!
4. SHIP BATTLE MODE - Excellent replacement for competitive mode. Battle of ships and Craken for 2 or 4 players
5. X - MASS ATTACK MODE - the most LoCa(craziest) mode. Combines a shooter, racing , presents, fun and great New Year spirit!
6. And lots of small features and bug fixes!!!
